method.settlement: outcome determined — held to resolution, or sold at >=0.998/<=0.002 into a market that resolved; win = actual winning side, never inferred from price
method.exit: swing trades — closed while the outcome was still live; win = sold above avg entry (profit)
method.merge: MERGE booked as a paired exit on both legs, $1 split pro-rata by entry
method.conversion: negRisk CONVERSION booked from its on-chain receipt: a SELL on each NO leg handed in, a BUY at market price on each YES leg received, cash-exact per conversion
method.hedges: concurrently two-sided markets excluded from calibration, kept in P&L
method.category: gamma event tags -> canonical category; venue tags ignored
method.closedOn: a lot is dated when its shares left the book — the last trade if sold, gamma's resolution date if held
